text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The grand culmination of this year's dirt season, the Tokyo Daishoten.
Look at that! The venue is packed with fans
eager to witness Smart Falcon's comeback!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Falco!! Falco!! Falco!!
Falco!! Falco!! Falco!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A dream race where the pinnacles of the old and new eras collide.
Please stand by just a little longer until post time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text: T-Things have gotten crazy out there...!? Is Tarumae-chan gonna be all right...!?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, let's believe in our star.
Come on, let's get the banner ready!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —We've finally made it this far.
choice_data_list: Now just give it everything you've got.
Now just give it everything you've got, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will run.
For the people of Tomakomai.
For everyone cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With all my heart and soul, I'll shine.
This is me. This is the star of Tomakomai.
This is Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: And... win...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I promise, I'll return to your side.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright then—
I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —You're here, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Things won't go like they did at the Champions Cup.
Today, I'll prove it once and for all!
The unshakeable power of my feng shui!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Ricky-chan is all prepped and ready,
and I'm ready-steady too~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: By matching everyone's brilliance against each other, let's make this Tokyo Daishoten the most dazzling stage in the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And so, let us welcome it.
...That great, magnificent light.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose.
Not to the two of them... and not to the one I admire!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —If Falco makes a breakaway~~~~???

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: We've got no choice but to chaaaaaaaase them!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone~!!!
And sorry to keep you waiting~!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco was totally sparkling today—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming to be the absolute center~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooo~☆
Shai-shai-shaaaaaai☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “—Tarumae-chan! We finally get to meet on this stage♪”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco-san—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(So this is Falco-san in a real race...!
Her presence is radiating so intensely...
I can't look away... I can barely breathe...!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Still, today I'm—!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "—I feel like I've been dreaming of running like this... forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's strange, isn't it?
...I was having a "dream," too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That we are competing for the top like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course, Rickey-chan, Acute-san, and everyone else too!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't let it become a two-horse race!
This time for sure...
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ It's time for a major upset!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—I suppose so.
Why don't we see whose radiance shines the brightest today?
...Right, Falco-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆
Let's make Ohi Racecourse the most dazzling place in the universe with our brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Letting everything I've built up shine...!!
The star of Tomakomai, right here!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin!!
Our—"dream" "Tokyo Daishoten"!!
